prelude.playerResolution: current Worldgroup session index is resolved to the active MajorMUD player record
prelude.optionalOutput: action metadata may emit local and room-scoped output before mutation

classes.behavior: toggle current action state at +0x374 between 0 and 2; mark +0x5F8 dirty; run room/action refresh helper; resolve linked record through +0x338 and per-slot mapping; require paired type 7 or 11; mirror the same toggle and refresh on the linked record

iterate all active sessions in the same room and dispatch local helper 0x00417692(session, actionIndex, 7); then process up to 15 nonzero room object identifiers at +0x400 through 0x004252F3(id, actionIndex, -1, 1), re-resolving the room record after possible movement

mode-indexed action-state mask clearing over bits 0x10 through 0x2000; mode 0 clears all ten bits; modes 1..10 clear one preceding bit, with duplicate-state suppression when +0x39C is nonnegative; when no controlled bit remains, force fallback state 8 and emit the configured room message
no type-specific branch in this routine; proceed directly to common finalization

commonFinalization: mark room/action record dirty at +0x5F8 when state is written
store resulting action state at +0x374 + actionIndex*4
optionally invoke 0x0043BBA3 with the resulting state when the active host slot is enabled
run session/action cleanup 0x004733F4 and output flush 0x0046B170
run host output finalization 0x00478B62 and optional status refresh 0x00431184
semanticPolicy: Numeric action-type names remain unassigned unless independently correlated with source records or UI text.
